exposure: Cervical dilation at admission (0-3 cm, 4-5 cm, 6-10 cm)
cohort: This study involved 285 pregnant women in the delivery rooms of Cengiz Gökçek Obstetrics and Pediatrics Hospital in Gaziantep, Türkiye.
finding: Low levels of cervical dilation at admission are associated with an increase in birth interventions (cesarean section, oxytocin use, episiotomy) and a decrease in birth satisfaction.
